questions.question: What is the commonly used name of Manchester United’s training ground?
questions.clue: Located in Greater Manchester, this famous training complex starts with the letter C.
questions.funFact: The Red Devils officially moved to this state-of-the-art training complex in 2000, replacing their historic former facility at The Cliff.

questions.question: Who is the manager of Coventry City?
questions.funFact: The former England international midfielder previously managed Derby County, Everton, and two spells at Chelsea before taking charge of the Sky Blues.

questions.question: On this day in history, 20th November, legendary player Pelé scored his 1,000th competitive goal. What nationality was Pelé?
questions.clue: A three-time FIFA World Cup winner who wore the iconic yellow number 10 jersey of the Seleção.
questions.funFact: He reached the historic milestone in 1969 at the Maracanã Stadium while playing for Santos against Vasco da Gama.

questions.question: Mauricio Pochettino has his first game in charge of Manchester United this weekend; who are they playing?
questions.clue: Manchester United's fiercest historic rivals from Merseyside.

questions.question: Which Premier League club has the youngest squad this season?
questions.clue: This West London club plays its home matches at Stamford Bridge.

questions.question: What shirt number did Harry Kane wear for the majority of his Tottenham career?
questions.clue: A classic double-digit playmaker and forward shirt number right after nine.
questions.funFact: After initially wearing number 37 and number 18, he inherited this famous jersey in 2015 and went on to become Spurs' all-time record goalscorer.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles did Didier Drogba win?
questions.clue: An even single-digit number equal to two multiplied by two.
questions.funFact: He won all four of his Premier League winner's medals across two separate spells at Stamford Bridge (2004–05, 2005–06, 2009–10, and 2014–15).

questions.question: Who is Chelsea’s top scorer so far this season?
questions.clue: A dynamic English attacking midfielder who previously starred at Aston Villa.
questions.funFact: His versatility, ball-carrying power, and clinical finishing have made him Chelsea's standout attacking threat in the final third this campaign.

questions.question: Which manager holds the Premier League record for reaching 100 victories in the fewest matches, achieving the milestone in just 134 games?
questions.clue: The Spanish tactician who led Manchester City to four consecutive Premier League titles.
questions.funFact: He smashed José Mourinho's previous record of 142 matches when Manchester City defeated Sheffield United 2–0 in December 2019.
